summary: 1.0.74 read the whole image from the owner's TK-350 but every slot showed empty. The driver hid channels outside 450-470 MHz. KPG-23D files saved in QEMU for 450-470 (sample.u1f) and 400-430 MHz (sample.u4f) prove the word encoding is band-independent; the band digit sits at 0x0D05 (P350n). Fix decodes all UHF bands; Web Programmer updated.
title: Full read completes but shows 0 channels
